entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Bug][Windows] MAUI has a chance to fail with 0xC0000409 crash in InputStateManager.dll when processing tap input #31476
  • [Android] HybridWebView briefly resizes to full screen when page is opened before snapping back to correct size #31475
  • Page.DisplayAlert(title, message, accept, cancel, flowDirection) is causing ArgumentNullException #31473
  • HybridWebViewQueryStringHelper.RemovePossibleQueryString removes '?' but not other special characters e.g. '#' #31472
  • I8_Header_and_Footer_Null - The page can be dragged down, and it would cause an extra space between Header and EmptyView text. #31465
  • Templates are not being updated under the "default" name #31461

Closed

  • Android.Graphics.BitmapFactory.Options crashes with JNI DETECTED ERROR IN APPLICATION: attempt to access field boolean android.graphics.BitmapFactory$Options.inMutable #30780
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • [NET10.0] Unable to deploy basic template on ios/android in release mode #31308
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • Permissions.CheckStatusAsync<Permissions.Bluetooth> on MacCatalyst maui returns Granted when don't allow is chosen #31455
    .NET 10.0-rc2
  • [Android] On Android the HorizontalOptions for FlexLayout does not work #31433
    .NET 10.0-rc2

    t/bug, platform/ios, area-controls-datetimepicker
